dependency_roles.numpy, scipy: all floating-point checks (DOP853 and Radau integrators, boundary-value solver, quadrature)
dependency_roles.mpmath: high-precision constants of the large-gain proof (40 and 50 digits) and the kurtosis quadratures (30 digits)
dependency_roles.numba (with llvmlite): only the recomputation of the uniqueness hunts in code/v3/v3_cartography.py; not needed with --quick

note: The framework suite of v2.0 was originally executed with numpy 2.3.5 and scipy 1.17.0 on Linux (provenance/v2_0_bundle/ENVIRONMENT.json); the versions above are those of the run recorded in evidence/run_receipt.json.
